transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this legal-review meeting. As we prepare for our initial response to the DOJ subpoena concerning commission payments made through our international distributors, I want to make sure we have a thorough roundtable discussion. Each of you, in your respective areas of responsibility, please share any material factual confirmations relevant to the proposed response terms so we can get them on the formal meeting record before I sign off on the submission.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd like to make a material factual confirmation for the record. While reviewing the subpoena and its incorporated definitions, I confirmed that the requested commission records cover exactly four distributors during calendar years 2019 through 2021. I have not yet updated the response packet because my subpoena-scope memorandum is still in review, but this scope confirmation should be noted as part of the formal meeting record before Elena signs off on the submission.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to make a material factual confirmation for the record. I completed a reconciliation of the commission ledger and supporting invoices, which shows exactly $275,000 in improper payments. This amount was confirmed with controllership yesterday, but it has not yet been added to the investigation materials. Given our DOJ-response policy, this confirmation of improper payments and the repayment figure is material to the proposed response and should be noted as part of the formal meeting record before Elena signs off on the submission.
